title: Personal Loans Returned-Payment Fees When a FlexLine Payment Bounced Too
content:
## Rule

The bank-event form of a Personal Loans returned-payment fee looks at the borrower's latest FlexLine returned payment and the borrower's latest FlexLine returned-payment fee (each on a tie of dates the first one recorded), read from the borrower's FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit records, against the loan's returned payment being charged:

1. when that FlexLine returned payment was debited from the same bank account and returned on the same date as the loan's returned payment and that FlexLine fee is dated that same date, the loan's own fee is cut to the loan's part of that one bank event (the FlexLine fee itself is left as it stands), so the loan's amount is the schedule amount times the loan's returned payment divided by the two returned payments together;
2. when that FlexLine fee is instead dated fewer than one whole calendar month (whole calendar months being the difference in calendar months, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's) before the assessment date and the two returns are not that one bank event, the loan's amount is the schedule amount less half that FlexLine fee, never below zero;
3. in every other case the FlexLine does not change the loan's amount.

That FlexLine returned-payment fee is taken net of every FlexLine fee waiver applied to it: one waived in full counts as no FlexLine fee, and one waived in part counts at its unwaived amount. On schedule C, whose schedule amount is 0.00, every one of these forms gives that amount or less, never below zero.

## Decision table

| Latest FlexLine return | Latest FlexLine returned-payment fee, net of waivers | Loan's amount |
|---|---|---|
| same bank account, same return date as the loan's | above 0.00 and dated that date | schedule amount times loan return over both returns together |
| not that one bank event | above 0.00, fewer than one whole month before the assessment date | schedule amount less half the FlexLine fee, not below zero |
| any | none, waived in full, or one whole month or more before | not changed |

## Cases (hypothetical schedule A loan, schedule amount 15.00, loan return 300.00)

- FlexLine return of 150.00 from the same account on the same date, FlexLine fee that date: 15.00 times 300.00 over 450.00 is 10.00.
- FlexLine fee of 10.00 dated 12 days before the assessment, from a different return date: 15.00 less 5.00 is 10.00.
- The same FlexLine fee waived 4.00 in part: counted at 6.00, so 15.00 less 3.00 is 12.00.
- FlexLine fee dated 2 March, assessment on 2 April: one whole month before, not changed: 15.00.
